CHECK BURST P6c-numbers — ONE uniform numbers table over every matrix cell, with ONE definition per metric (the per-cell checks were written by different bursts with differing definitions). REPORT ONLY. task_id "P6c-numbers".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/<animation>_<DIR>/frames/<animation>/<DIR>/<animation>_<DIR>_NN.png (+ frames/rest/<DIR>/rest_<DIR>.png, registration.json) for the cells present; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/missing.json; /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/matrix_index.json. Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ (run, never modify): gates/g6_seam.py (evaluate → G6 literal/G6b; g6c for walk/run), gates/g1_height.py, gates/matte_quality.py (rim_luma_excess). python glue importing them is fine; no new tool files.

For EVERY cell present compute, identically: n_frames; fps_out (registration.json); G6b value (g6_seam.evaluate); G6c (walk/run only); G1 max = max over frames of |H_frame/H_rest − 1| (g1_height.evaluate(frame, rest)); closure_mad = mean over the alpha-union of |RGB_first − RGB_last| (straight RGB, pixels where max(alpha) ≥ 128) — for loops first=frame 0 last=frame N−1, for one-shots first=rest last=frame N−1; rim_mean = mean rim_luma_excess over frames; motion_range_H = (max − min of the alpha-bbox top row across frames) / H_rest; lateral_range_H = (max − min of the alpha-bbox centre-x) / H_rest. Write out/numbers.json = {"definitions":{…one line each…}, "cells":{"<animation>_<DIR>":{…}}, "missing":<copy of missing.json>} and out/numbers.csv (one row per cell). Every value is a report; no pass/fail field.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P6c-numbers"; images []; files: out/numbers.json, out/numbers.csv with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
